eyebrow: A receipt token as the connector
code:
Deposit ETH into a lending pool
  -> receive an aToken (receipt: deposit + accruing interest)
  -> use that aToken as collateral in a DIFFERENT protocol
  -> borrow against it, without withdrawing the original ETH
caption: An aToken is an ordinary ERC-20 — no custom integration needed elsewhere.

code:
1. Borrow 1,000,000 USDC (flash loan, zero collateral)
2. Trade across two AMMs for a price difference (arbitrage)
3. Repay 1,000,000 USDC + fee to the flash-loan pool
   -> if step 3 fails, steps 1 and 2 never happened
caption: The whole transaction reverts — there is no partial, half-settled state.
